prior_operator_scope: Earlier tests packed a single pair of LoRA gradients. This claim compares the real DDP reducer bucket policy at the full trainable tensor count with four accumulated microbatches.
design: Use independent intra-node eight-rank DDP process groups, ABBA 25/8/8/25 MiB, identical rank inputs and parameters between arms, 1 device numerical update and 3 warm and 15 timed updates per block, reported at the slowest rank. The 8-card pilot reduces the counts to 1/1/2. The actual DDP bucket metadata is recorded.
environment: Pinned original DTK sandbox and RCCL. Generated repeatable inputs, complete shape-defined LoRA-only forward/backward and AdamW, no frozen full model.
exclusions: Keep old MiniCPM original request reservations and two previously observed external KFD holders. Node worker independently checks current KFD and PCI.
formal_qualification: No native full-model numeric, A100 throughput, recovery, held-out or Stage3 claims.
